title: The Social Security (Miscellaneous Amendments) Regulations (Northern Ireland) 2026
summary: These Regulations make amendments to the Social Security (Recovery of Benefits) Regulations (Northern Ireland) 1997 (S.R. 1997 No. 429), the State Pension Credit Regulations (Northern Ireland) 2003 (S.R. 2003 No. 28), the Housing Benefit Regulations (Northern Ireland) 2006 (S.R. 2006 No. 405), the Housing Benefit (Persons who have attained the qualifying age for state pension credit) Regulations (Northern Ireland) 2006 (S.R. 2006 No. 406), the Social Security (Recovery of Benefits) (Lump Sum Payments) Regulations (Northern Ireland) 2008 (S.R. 2008 No. 355), the Employment and Support Allowance Regulations (Northern Ireland) 2008 (S.R. 2008 No. 280), the Universal Credit Regulations (Northern Ireland) 2016 (S.R. 2016 No. 216), the Universal Credit (Transitional Provisions) Regulations (Northern Ireland) 2016 (S.R. 2016 No. 226), the Social Security (Overpayments and Recovery) Regulations (Northern Ireland) 2016 (S.R. 2016 No. 224) and the Personal Independence Payment (Transitional Provisions) Regulations (Northern Ireland) 2016 (S.R. 2016 No. 227).

title: Correction Slip
summary: These Regulations amend the Tobacco Retailer (Fixed Penalty) (Amount) Regulations (Northern Ireland) 2016 (“the Regulations”).

title: The Enterprise Act 2002 (Specification of Additional Section 58 Consideration) Order 2026
summary: Section 58 of the Enterprise Act 2002 (“the Act”) specifies the public interest considerations in relation to which the Secretary of State may intervene in relevant merger situations (as defined in section 23 of the Act) and special merger situations (as defined in section 59 of the Act).

title: The Armed Forces (Service Complaints) (Amendment) (No. 2) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations amend the Armed Forces (Service Complaints) Regulations 2015 (S.I. 2015/1955) (“the 2015 Regulations”).

title: The Social Security (Income and Capital Disregards) (Amendment) Regulations 2026
summary: Regulations 2 to 6 amend respectively the State Pension Credit Regulations 2002 (S.I. 2002/1792), the Housing Benefit Regulations 2006 (S.I. 2006/213), the Housing Benefit (Persons who have attained the qualifying age for state pension credit) Regulations 2006 (S.I. 2006/214), the Employment and Support Allowance Regulations 2008 (S.I. 2008/794), and the Universal Credit Regulations 2013 (S.I. 2013/376).

title: Northern Ireland Fiscal Council Act (Northern Ireland) 2026
summary: An Act to make provision for the establishment and functions of the Northern Ireland Fiscal Council; and for connected purposes.

title: The Housing (Scotland) Act 2025 (Commencement No. 4 and Transitional Provisions) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations bring into force a number of the provisions of the Housing (Scotland) Act 2025 (“the Act”) on 9 November 2026, 1 April 2027 and 1 August 2027.

title: The Armed Forces Commissioner Act 2025 (Commencement No. 2) Regulations 2026
summary: These are the second commencement Regulations made under the Armed Forces Commissioner Act 2025 (c. 23) (“the 2025 Act”).
